n: New in the story: four chapters about the worlds past the multiverse, right after After the Wall, with four new characters: Facet the crystal, Alev (Vela's reflection), Morrow the sleepy dreamer and Lumen, the first light
Already past that point? The new chapters count as done and their rewards are yours. Watch them in Crew › Story
The new worlds pay out a lot more: Fractal, Mirror, Dream and Origin now each multiply all your energy production, and the deeper the world, the bigger the boost
Fixed: Watch the ending again played the wrong chapter, and the chapter reward line said ×2 when it gives ×1.5
